about.title: Uburyo
about.lead: Hunika igereranya kugurisha ubu no kubika amezi 1 kugeza kuri 4. Ikoresha intera y'imyaka ishize, kandi igira inama yo kubika gusa iyo inyungu ishoboka ari yo kandi iyo hasi atari mbi cyane.
about.ai: Kode n'aya magambo yanditswe na Grok Build ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2026. Inyandiko y'imikorere yari yandikiwe Claude. Itsinda rigisuzuma imibare n'amagambo yose y'ikinyarwanda.
about.notice: Inama ishingiye ku biciro byashize. Si isezerano.
about.wfp: Ibiciro bya WFP, binyuze kuri HDX, byakuwe ku wa 25 Ukwakira 2026. Ukwezi gushya mu dosiye: Kanama 2026.
about.cpi: Igipimo cy'ibiciro by'ibiribwa mu cyaro cya NISR kugeza Nyakanga 2026, cyatangajwe ku wa 10 Ukwakira 2026.
about.sas: Imbonerahamwe za SAS 2025 za NISR, zatangajwe ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2025.
about.ahs: Ubushakashatsi bw'ingo z'abahinzi bwa 2024 ntiburaboneka muri iyi porogaramu. Bugomba gukurwa ku rubuga rwa NISR.
